title: Oddballs Survival
description: A public survival server. Yeah. You can sell things. You can build. You can claim. It works on bedrock too, for now.
body:
# **ODDBALLS SURVIVAL ✨**

![An image of minecraft, sunset, with a castle](https://aethyr.kill-all.men/7FHgE9Bps.png)

Oddballs Survival is a Survival Minecraft server made by VTuber Aethyrnet. It's a small server that supports Java and Bedrock crossplay with features like a player-driven economy, quests, jobs, and skills. The server is still being developed, and new feature suggestions are always welcome. Join now, and enjoy your stay!
